body.zh: 两种可溶盐混合时，若某种离子组合难溶，就会析出固体沉淀。氯化钙与碳酸钠混合生成白色碳酸钙，钠离子和氯离子留在溶液中旁观。浑浊来自悬浮的细小颗粒，静置后会沉降分层。
body.en: Mixing two soluble salts can precipitate an insoluble ion pair. CaCl₂ + Na₂CO₃ yields white CaCO₃ while Na⁺ and Cl⁻ spectate. Turbidity comes from suspended fine particles that settle into a layer on standing.

misconception.zh: 变浑浊不是“起了雾”，而是生成了悬浮的固体微粒。
misconception.en: Cloudiness is not 'fog' — it is suspended solid particles forming.
